title: SimpleChatFilter
description: Chat Mod with Chat Lock, Spam Prevention and Profanity Filter.
body:
# SimpleChatFilter ## Features - Lock Chat, preventing anyone from speaking - Clear Chat, clearing out any old messages - Prevent Profanity, with a chat filter - Spam Punishment Tracks, preventing excessive spam ## Permissions - simplechatfilter.commands - Used to run anything followed by /simpleChatFilter - simplechatfilter.reload - for reloading - simplechatfilter.clearchat - to clear chat - simplechatfilter.lockchat - to lock or unlock chat - simplechatfilter.bypass - to bypass chat lock ## ❓ Need Help?
You can either DM me on discord @polarplar or join my development discord and ask your questions there! Also check out my other projects!
